audit_items.proof_trace: The resolved code_scope (process_slashings, L1782-1798) is a mismatch -- it only decreases balances for validators already flagged slashed and has no justification/quorum logic; the actual enforcement is weigh_justification_and_finalization, which justifies a checkpoint only when attesting balance * 3 >= total_active_balance * 2 (L1524, L1529), combined with is_slashable_attestation_data (L749-760) which implements exactly the double-vote (same target epoch, differing data) and surround-vote predicates the Lean theorem's slashing condition assumes, and is_valid_indexed_attestation (L765-779) which forces sorted/unique attesting indices under a verified aggregate signature so a validator's weight cannot be double-counted within one quorum. Since two conflicting 2/3-weight quorums for the same epoch height necessarily overlap by >=1/3 of stake (2/3+2/3>1), and any validator counted in both quorums has by construction cast two distinct-data attestations for the same target epoch (a double vote under is_slashable_attestation_data), the implementation's justification threshold and slashing predicate satisfy the theorem's must-establish precondition -- the proof holds and survives stress-testing (both mechanisms verified directly, not by name similarity).
